name: S-Class Brigand
body:
S-class brigands are savvy highwaymen who can put the fear in their enemies with a glance. When they do engage in combat, they are cunning warriors, able to avoid otherwise deadly strikes while dealing out their own.

Skill Ranks per Level

4 + Int modifier

Hit Dice and Base Attack Bonus

An s-class brigand’s Hit Die is a d10, and the base attack bonus he gains from this class is equal to his brigand level.

Class Features

An s-class brigand gains all of the same class features as the brigand, except as noted here.

Favored Weapon Training (Ex)

At 5th level, an s-class brigand gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with his favored weapon. He adds his brigand and fighter levels together when determining his weapon training progression.

At 9th, 13th, and 17th level, the brigand can choose another weapon with which he’s proficient. That weapon also counts as a favored weapon for the brigand. He gains the +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with that weapon, and increases another of his favored weapon’s bonuses by +1.

Alternatively, the brigand can choose an advanced weapon training option that he could learn with one of his favored weapons. This replaces the +1 bonus he would gain at that level.

Keep Your Cool (Ex)

At 2nd level, an s-class brigand gains Combat Expertise as a bonus feat. When he uses Combat Expertise with his favored weapon, the penalty he takes on attack rolls is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of +0). The penalty is reduced by 2 at 7th level, 3 at 12th level, and 4 at 17th level.

Alternatively, the brigand can take the feat’s normal penalty on to attacks and increase the dodge bonus it grants to his AC by +1, +2, +3, and +4 in those same intervals.
